Title: SN->SR->LLR->TC join + orphan set
Detail: Loads the four registries, computes the orphan set (SR without LLR/TC, LLR/TC without a parent, SN without an SR), and exits 1 under --strict.

Title: Id + CSV-structure + citation integrity
Detail: Duplicate/malformed id detection per ID_PATTERNS, a per-row column-count check, and SR/LLR citation coherence (triangle_findings, Thread 50); the always-valid --strict-integrity floor.

Title: Placeholder + schema checks
Detail: -000 example-row scan and required-field + closed-vocabulary validation over the real (non-placeholder) rows, plus the ratified-phase completeness rule: once any spine row is phased, a non-Draft SR/LLR/TC whose Phase does not digit-parse to a number is a --strict-schema finding (vacuous until armed; a downstream vN parses and passes).

Title: Comparative-term advisory
Detail: Flags an AcceptanceCriteria comparative term with no predicate marker in the cell; warn-only, never joins the failure set.

Title: Off-spine integrity + back-links
Detail: Integrity-checks the PB/REPO/PART/ASSET ids plus legacy MOD compatibility and resolves REPO/MOD DelegatedSRs against the SR set; -000 example rows ignored.

Title: Gate step plan + missing-tool guard
Detail: Builds the required-step plan per gate/tier and reports SKIP(missing) with a nonzero exit when a required tool is absent.

Title: Stack profile loader
Detail: Reads format/lint/test/tiers/coverage/arch-map from docs/stack.ini and resolves each step's command from that profile.

Title: Profile validation
Detail: Rejects a malformed profile, non-integer coverage threshold, or missing declared binary with a clear loud failure.

Title: Conditional profile seeding
Detail: Selects the file/skill set per stack+domain scope; omits Python-only artifacts and seeds files-mode arch-map for a non-Python stack.

Title: Scaffold writer
Detail: Writes the mapped kit files into --dest so the generated harness runs green out of the box.

Title: Idempotent write + kit-version stamp
Detail: Skips an existing file unless --force; write_kit_version stamps docs/kit-version (SHA + date, -dirty on an uncommitted kit tree) so a re-sync is diffable.

Title: Link + vision-tag checker
Detail: Resolves intra-repo links, requires a PROJECT-VISION tag, and checks generated-doc freshness under --stale.

Title: Flow-doc contract checker
Detail: Validates an authored runtime-flow doc against its structural contract; a malformed flow fails.

Title: Budget comparator
Detail: Compares measured metrics to declared budgets and fails beyond tolerance at the row's block/warn level.

Title: PB back-link resolution
Detail: Resolves each PB row's Refs to a real SR/LLR/Module id; an empty or unresolvable Refs is a finding.

Title: Stub marker detector
Detail: Walks the AST for stub bodies (pass-only/NotImplemented/ellipsis public functions) at the declared gate.

Title: Secrets pattern scan
Detail: Always-on scan of staged diff/message/outgoing range for PEM/token/key patterns, independent of the privacy toggle.

Title: Two-axis privacy gating
Detail: Adds the PII/identity classes when docs/privacy-check is on, exempting configured author identities.

Title: Pre-commit floor
Detail: Runs trace --strict-integrity and the check_privacy secrets scan on staged content and blocks a failing commit.

Title: Pre-push outgoing scan
Detail: Scans the outgoing commit range and blocks a push that would publish a secret or a private identity under privacy-check.

Title: Hook python probe
Detail: Probes candidate interpreters by running one and skip-or-reports clearly when none works or a Store-alias exits nonzero.

Title: Vendored-doc drift check
Detail: Compares a vendored doc copy against its recorded upstream source and reports drift.

Title: Arch-map splice + drift check
Detail: Regenerates the symbol map inside the BEGIN/END marker block and fails --check when the committed map has drifted.

Title: Permutation expander
Detail: Parses the Permutations grammar (range/set/bool with @full|@pairwise|@boundaries) and emits the concrete case set.

Title: Skills index generator
Detail: Reads each SKILL.md applicability frontmatter and regenerates skills/INDEX.csv.

Title: Headless session launch
Detail: Runs the agent CLI headless: build_argv substitutes {model} into argv and, when a CmdTemplate carries no {prompt} placeholder (the default for both claude and codex - WI-217), routes the prompt to the child's STDIN (run_session writes it from a daemon thread then closes) so a large prompt survives the OS command-line cap (Windows codex.CMD 8191-char cmd.exe / 32767-char CreateProcess - the round's ~70k briefs exceed even argv), while the no-wedge invariant holds (a fixed prompt + EOF, never an interactive read; WI-216). A codex session additionally captures codex's own --output-last-message file as the result (_codex_lastmsg_setup/_codex_lastmsg_read), since codex echoes its banner + the whole prompt into stdout (WI-217). stdin is otherwise closed so no prompt wedges the loop (WI-210: the scope is the dispatcher + worker sessions; the status.md-resume read is retired).

Title: Preflight footing guard
Detail: Refuses a non-git dir, a missing agent CLI, or a private author under privacy-check with a typed nonzero exit rather than hanging.

Title: Typed outcome + ERROR handling
Detail: Ends each session in a typed code, guards a zero-commit HEAD, and reports an all-ERROR region as an unavailable agent, not a work stall.

Title: Kernel advisory lock
Detail: Takes an OS advisory lock the kernel releases on process death, so no stale-pid file wedges the next run.

Title: Lock mutual exclusion
Detail: Refuses a second coordinator holding the same per-worktree lock, preventing a two-writer race.

Title: Shared declared-line parse
Detail: The single first-non-comment-line reader the hooks, agent_loop.read_declared, and check_privacy all use so a declared policy value is read one way.

Title: Onboard/dev-setup templates
Detail: The onboarding and dev-setup scaffold scripts that materialize and run to a green developer setup; dev-setup also wires the pre-commit floor (core.hooksPath) from its baseline.

Title: Release checklist generator
Detail: Emits docs/release-checklist.md, including a Performance-budgets section listing each warn-tier PB (id + allocation) read from the budgets registry.

Title: WI dependency-DAG validation
Detail: Loads work-items.csv; validates WI ids, predecessor resolution, and hard-edge acyclicity; respects the absent/placeholder/opt-out vacuity rules.

Title: Offline project-state core
Detail: Renders one self-contained root HTML file with completeness tiles, the spine hierarchy, and the WI roadmap DAG.

Title: Duplicate-block detector
Detail: Tokenizes each source file (stdlib tokenize; comments/NL/indent excluded, NEWLINE kept so windows cannot stitch unrelated statements), slides a --min-tokens window (default 30), groups candidate hits by line offset, and merges only step-1-overlapping token-window offsets into one finding per block, POSIX-normalizes the file pair, and fingerprints each block (a hash of its complete token signature, line-number-free). A finding is suppressed only when its fingerprint+pair is recorded in docs/dupes-allow (count-aware: N lines sanction N identical copies) or a legacy bare pair matches; --emit-census prints the lines.

Title: Per-phase cmd map + size tripwire
Detail: cmd_map parsed by parse_map (same KEY=value syntax; templates may not contain , or ; — the dispatcher wrapper covers those); session_template(phase) falls back to AGENT_CMD; every map entry preflighted (parse + executable); review-policy read via read_declared and printed in the banner; status_size_warning is pure and warn-only (limit<=0 disables).

Title: Path + sym: reference checker
Detail: Scans root *.md + docs/**/*.md; a backticked token is path-shaped when it carries a separator plus a known extension or top-level prefix (URLs/globs/placeholders excluded); GENERATED marker blocks and path-ok lines are skipped; sym:<module>.<name> is resolved against the module map parsed from architecture.md (module tail -> public symbols); warn-first, --strict exits 1.

Title: OKF bundle emitter
Detail: emit() builds {relpath: content} for every real row (sorted, deterministic, no timestamps): frontmatter via JSON-quoted YAML scalars, bodies carrying the row prose plus up/down markdown links from locally built reverse maps, per-tier and root indexes, the UPSTREAM.md spec pin; on_disk() snapshots docs/okf for the byte-compare; write mode writes-if-changed and prunes; small loaders duplicated per the F5 rule (no new sibling import). Layer B2 adds a process-guides tier: _doc_title_and_summary derives each guide title+summary from the doc first heading/paragraph (inline links stripped so nothing dangles), emitted only after the vacuity gate so a fresh scaffold stays vacuous.

Title: Subagent spawn gate
Detail: Pure decide(tool_name, policy, override) -> allow|ask|deny|defer over SPAWN_TOOLS={Task,Agent}; main reads the PreToolUse JSON payload, reads docs/subagent-gate via the shared declared-line parse, applies the SUBAGENT_GATE=allow override, emits permissionDecision (deny -> exit 2), and appends each decision to docs/subagent-gate.log; any exception fails OPEN (allow) and logs, so a broken gate never wedges the agent's tools.

Title: IF-tier integrity
Detail: Loads interfaces.csv; validates IF ids, SR back-links and Component tags, and emits the best-effort endpoint-module advisory.

Title: Architecture-connectivity coverage warns
Detail: Emits opt-out warn-first findings for missing endpoints/directions, uncited Active seams, and dangling Contracts citations without changing exit status.

Title: Agent pair-row routing
Detail: Parses pair rows and enable tokens; resolves versions; merges Env; selects by tier, family, cooldown, and order with legacy Provider compatibility.

Title: Managed review dispatch
Detail: Schedules review-policy sessions in managed mode, constructs redacted prompt-map briefs, parses verdicts, logs selections, and preserves unmanaged behavior.

Title: Review substance scorer
Detail: Computes advisory substance components and decay history; treats tripwires as gates and never rewards length.

Title: Cross-agent skill fan-out drift check
Detail: gen_skills_index.check_agent_sync byte-compares each per-agent <agent>/skills/<name>/ file (.claude/.gemini/.agents) to the neutral project-trajectory/skills/<name>/ source; a copy that diverges is a --check-agents finding with a one-command fix, an orphan copy (no source) a non-failing warn, a source skill missing from a subset dir no finding. Vacuous without a source or per-agent dir; wired as the check.py skills-sync step + pre-commit floor (kit-only generator, so a scaffold no-ops). bootstrap.sync_agent_skills (--sync) force-refreshes only the <agent>/skills/<name>/ subtree from source.

Title: Run capability menu reader
Detail: load_capabilities parses the docs/stack.ini [run] section (configparser, interpolation=None, case-preserving optionxform; declaration order kept; a name.desc row attaches to its command and an orphan or empty-value command is dropped) into an ordered (name,command,desc) list; --list prints name<TAB>desc per row; direct(name) launches by exact-match name (exit 2 on an unknown name) and launch() runs the shell line via subprocess shell=True - the user's own declared command, the same trust boundary as the retired RUN_CMD - passing the child exit code straight through; interactive_menu prints the numbered menu, reads a pick from stdin, and returns EOF-safe without hanging; an absent or empty [run] prints guidance and exits 1. The run.* launchers are thin delegates forwarding their args to run_menu.py.

Title: Independent critique dispatch
Detail: Detects Critique-scoped builds and assembles a fresh family-heterogeneous rubric/intent/artifact brief with no self-assessment.

Title: Bounded software top view
Detail: Derives component roots and uncontained modules; enforces TOP_VIEW_MAX with nesting, opt-out, and vacuity rules.

Title: Derived-gate computation + hybrid cache
Detail: Per-artifact gate rules (sr_gate/maturity_gate/sn_gate) + min-aggregation over in-scope artifacts + the cached docs/gate (basis line + --check rot guard, legacy value-only); the derived current phase (max over ratified rows via phase_num) rides the basis line and --print, the phase analogue of the derived gate.

Title: Process reference tab
Detail: Renders the Process tab as a fully self-contained conditional panel registered in build_html (the Knowledge-tab pattern: nav button + section id=process): (1) the artifact-lifecycle x gates panel derived from the live registries + docs/gate (current-gate highlight; per-tier counts from the spine), (2) the resume-loop panel (the managed agent_loop flow with its escalation edges), (3) the slices -> phase -> gates panel derived from work-items.csv; links out to the process masters wherever a canonical home exists (bounded in-view restatement only where no single doc states the relationship); sorted inputs, no clocks; a data-less repo renders byte-identically; --check unchanged (the trajectory-map step).

Title: Tiered When roadmap
Detail: Builds phase/workstream/WI tiers by threshold, surfaces delivery Phase, and aggregates parent edges from deduplicated child edges.

Title: Dashboard accessibility rendering
Detail: Renders PROJECT_STATE.html operable and readable without a pointer or full colour perception: every interactive element (tab buttons, expandable <details> blocks, SVG nodes with detail panels) is keyboard-reachable (native focusable elements or tabindex+key handler) and carries an accessible name (a <title>/aria-label or visible text); every status/phase/type encoding pairs its colour with a text or shape cue (never colour alone); text keeps a contrast ratio against its fill at or above the threshold declared in docs/rubrics/dashboard-accessibility.md (WCAG 2.1 AA). The design is adjudicated against that rubric by the SR-084/SR-085 critique loop - this LLR names the code surface the critique judges (Critique is non-LLR-exempt per SR-086). Self-contained, byte-deterministic; --check unchanged.

Title: Dashboard UI-uniformity rendering
Detail: One shared style system across every tab and SVG emitter: a single type scale + spacing rhythm and one status/phase/type colour vocabulary applied wherever the same concept renders; uniform node/edge/legend/detail-panel styling across the dag_svg/sw_graph/when_view emitters; the same interaction idiom (expand, hover, detail) wherever the same structure appears. Factored to shared style constants/helpers so the emitters cannot drift. Adjudicated against docs/rubrics/dashboard-uniformity.md by the SR-084/SR-085 critique loop. Byte-deterministic; --check unchanged.

Title: Dashboard usability rendering
Detail: Supports the core reading tasks with low friction: a first-time reviewer reaches the project state, the next work, and how the parts connect each within one tab switch (the landing view surfaces or one-click links to each - the concrete task list lives in docs/rubrics/dashboard-usability.md); labels stay readable at default zoom with no clipped or overlapping text. Adjudicated against the usability rubric by the SR-084/SR-085 critique loop. Byte-deterministic; --check unchanged. NARROWED by the WI-300 (f) ruling (2026-07-25): the MECHANIZED cores of anchors T2 and T3 have left this LLR for child rows that name the tests owning them - T2 start-collapse -> LLR-099/TC-102, T3 breadcrumb-restores-parent -> LLR-100/TC-103. This LLR keeps only what a TC cannot pin, so the critique no longer re-judges what a test enforces. Do NOT restate a child's claim here: an anchor lives in exactly one row.

Title: Process tab intake + human-decision loop panels
Detail: Extends SR-050's process_panel with the project's two circular working loops as linked flow panels: (A) the intake loop - owner/agent intake -> triage into work items with spec detail -> the scheduler-derived ready frontier in work-items.csv -> build/review -> merge; (B) the human-decision loop - open-items population (incl. the gate-ratification table) -> human review and ruling -> the log's Decisions record -> merge - with the LLM_Agent entry node rendered once and shared by both loops. Each stage links to its canonical home (status.md, work-items.csv, open-items.md, log.md); data-derived where a canonical source exists; a data-less repo renders byte-identically; --check unchanged (the trajectory-map step).

Title: Decomposition render polish (columns, arrows, persistent hover)
Detail: Polishes the tiered decomposition render: each tier column is sized no wider than its content within a declared bound (a per-tier max-width cap MAX_TIER_COL, not the current uniform column); one horizontal parent->child arrow is drawn per containment edge so containment is explicit rather than implied by nesting alone; and the hover/focus highlight persists on the last-hovered item until another takes it (a stateful highlight keyed to the last-hovered node id, killing the flash-on-exit). Self-contained, byte-deterministic; --check unchanged. Composes with SR-089's tiering without changing its >3 thresholds.

Title: WI-DAG frontier + deterministic traincar ordering
Detail: Derives the dependency-ready frontier from the WI registry + dispatcher reservations (never prose), excludes blocked/deferred/reserved/protected-/exclusive-conflicting WIs with reason codes, and orders eligible traincars by (gate, Priority desc, downstream-dependent count desc, hard-path desc, first WI id); exposes ready --explain / --format json and simulate --jobs N.

Title: Pure safety classifier
Detail: Maps declared safety and policy inputs to one scheduling class and deterministic reason codes without side effects.

Title: next-wi/run-phase retirement + generated status/run-state
Detail: Deletes docs/next-wi + docs/run-phase and every live dependency across agent_loop/prompts/checks/bootstrap/process/tests; makes status.md an integrator-generated freshness-gated snapshot (never on a worker branch) and run-state a generated RUNNING|NEEDS-HUMAN|BLOCKED|DONE outcome; translates no former next-wi content into Priority.

Title: Explicit WI/train/worktree worker assignment
Detail: Replaces internal --track assumptions with explicit --wi/--train/worktree assignment; assembles the worker prompt from AGENTS.md + WI row + SpecRef + predecessor context + train diff + rework finding (never status.md/next-wi); collision-safe per-assignment logs/review evidence naming the exact reviewed commit; the --track lane machinery is retired outright (WI-210).

Title: Dispatcher + worktree pool + atomic reservations
Detail: agent-resume dispatcher/integrator with --jobs (default 2)/auto/AGENT_JOBS; reconcile->gate->build-out launch; packs the frontier into traincars and dispatches dependency-clear ones to free workers; reserves constituents atomically via refs/llm/reservations/WI-### (commit-tree metadata + update-ref --stdin zero-old-value); leases worktrees; rescans for dynamic refill; honors pause/blackout/capacity.

Title: Traincar continuation + fork/join + release-on-end
Detail: Continues a lane onto the reserved traincar's single hard successor while conditions hold (classifier permits, cap default 4); one Build pass + one review cycle with the policy-required verdict count, no constituent done until the train integrates; releases unstarted reservations + recomputes the DAG on any early end; a fork integrates the parent then splits, a join starts from the combined HEAD.

Title: Serialized train composition
Detail: Applies and reviews one train through the serialized writer, regenerates authority, runs the combined bar, and CAS-advances integration.

Title: Git evidence enumeration
Detail: Enumerates durable reservations, train commits, integration refs, and publication intents before choosing or initializing authority.

Title: Parallel telemetry + downstream migration/audits
Detail: Reason-coded events aggregated by (train, WI, session) + a lanes/frontier/queue/ceiling banner; downstream migration holds --jobs 1 until the soft-edge audit AND the SafetyClass audit pass, then records the two-worker flip; reconciles legacy active rows + docs/tracks/* within one compatibility window.

Title: Cross-component import coverage
Detail: Joins imports, component membership, and declared seams; reports uncovered cross-component edges with strict/plain and vacuity rules.

Title: Fresh-session dual-plan runner
Detail: Runs planners, cross-critiques, bounded revisions and position-swapped arbiters as fresh sessions; selects only true-plan agreement.

Title: Generated-status source-of-truth guard
Detail: Finds done WI tokens only in hand-edited status.md, with plain/strict severity, and stands down for the generated marker, open/unknown ids, opt-out, and absent status.

Title: Dual-plan artifact persistence and filer
Detail: Allocates stable round/stage artifacts and appends registry-valid selected child WIs with mapped predecessors and preserved line endings.

Title: Coverage-step result adapter
Detail: Converts coverage CLI results and report payload into clean, implicated-repair, repeated-failure, or malformed round records.

Title: Dual-plan planner pair and fallback
Detail: Selects two fresh planner sessions across families where possible and applies the bounded nonresponse fallback with reason codes.

Title: Allowlist-only dual-plan briefs
Detail: Builds planner/critic/arbiter briefs only from SR/IF registries with strict template slots and override/fallback loading.

Title: Typed dual-plan round lifecycle
Detail: Implements typed round steps, spend and action caps, position-swapped agreement, persistence, and PAGE mapping.

Title: Rival-plan coverage comparison
Detail: Parses rival plan tables; resolves clause/SR/IF coverage; validates dependencies; emits pairwise differences and distinct findings/malformed/absent-registry outcomes.

Title: Spec interface-section validation
Detail: Validates armed spec interface ids, Proposed rationale, and the intra-module escape with warn-first/strict severity.

Title: WI row coherence
Detail: Enforces Deliverable iff done on every run and resolvable open-WI SpecRef under strict mode.

Title: Conditional architecture and knowledge views
Detail: Renders software/component and OKF views only when their source bundles exist; omits each otherwise.

Title: Deterministic responsive dashboard freshness
Detail: Produces deterministic responsive HTML; implements stale/missing --check and a git as-of stamp excluded from stamp-only comparison.

Title: Declared-interface graph rendering
Detail: Renders IF-labeled seams in dashboard and architecture views with deterministic table fallback when absent.

Title: Fixed review escalation
Detail: Applies win-stay/lose-shift family swap, tier escalation, and gate-policy paging for shared failure, contradiction, and tripwires.

Title: Bounded critique rework
Detail: Loops CHANGES-REQUESTED through rework and fresh critique within AGENT_CRITIQUE_MAX, then pages via gate policy.

Title: Critique verification vocabulary
Detail: Accepts Critique as a verification value while retaining the LLR completeness requirement.

Title: Critique closure ratchet
Detail: Warns when a Critique-scoped WI closes after CHANGES-REQUESTED with no TC, test, or rubric delta.

Title: Containerized How-SW rendering
Detail: Renders nested component membership and boundary-aggregated seams, falling back byte-identically to the flat view without containment.

Title: Tiered How-SW hierarchy
Detail: Tiers component containment to modules and bounds the visible top level by TOP_VIEW_MAX.

Title: Hierarchy seam ports
Detail: Attaches IF seams to visible input/output ports and aggregates cross-container seams at boundaries.

Title: One-layer hierarchy navigation
Detail: Handles pointer and keyboard one-layer descent and breadcrumb restoration in self-contained views.

Title: Structural safety cross-check
Detail: Cross-checks declarations against spine, critique, checkpoint, and dual-plan evidence; quarantines only the contradictory WI.

Title: Safety-aware traincar packing
Detail: Packs ordinary chains, serializes protected work, isolates forced-single work, and batches only homogeneous cap-bounded spine-serial work.

Title: Serialized blocked disposition
Detail: Commits a smaller blocker-only disposition carrying BlockRef/evidence and no review-pass claim.

Title: Durable publication intent
Detail: Persists expected-old and target hashes, CAS-publishes, and syncs only a clean/expected development worktree with recoverable failure evidence.

Title: Ownership-state reconstruction
Detail: Reconstructs one owner/state per WI and train from Git evidence; quarantines ambiguity and duplicate claims.

Title: Lifecycle-boundary recovery
Detail: Recovers each reservation/integration/publication fault boundary without runtime-cache authority or evidence loss.

Title: Dual-plan path isolation
Detail: Rejects dual rows on the direct worker path and derives contradiction-safe single-WI scheduling from PlanMode.

Title: Serialized dual-plan disposition
Detail: Commits SELECT or PAGE as one docs-only disposition, regenerates validation, and applies gate-policy continuation semantics; the --dual-plan single-shot round applies the same PAGE gate-policy mapping (attended pages, autonomous/single-ratify STALLs).

Title: Spec-lifecycle close-side findings
Detail: Emits R-F findings - done WI with non-empty SpecRef; live docs/specs file (README/-000 excluded, the spec_interface_findings idiom) with no open-WI citer - message-only, riding main's warn-plain/error-under-strict tier with no new branch.

Title: Per-module coverage-floor comparator
Detail: Reads the docs/coverage-floors census (module + min percent; blank and # lines ignored) and coverage.py's JSON report (per-file percent_covered, path-normalized), fails on any module below its floor or absent from the report, SKIPs when the report is absent, is a no-op with an empty census, and fails loudly on a malformed floor line.

Title: Default-density start-collapse (T2 core)
Detail: The MECHANIZED core of usability anchor T2 (docs/rubrics/dashboard-usability.md), split out of LLR-055 under the WI-300 (f) ruling: a view whose scale EARNS tiering - a bundle spanning > 3 OKF types, a module set above the component threshold (the SR-089 '>3' rule) - renders START-COLLAPSED as the shared type-tiered drill, one block per type/container, rather than a flat wall of nodes; at or below the threshold it stays flat, so the tiering is earned by scale and never imposed on a small project. SCOPE (deliberately narrower than the prose anchor): the Knowledge and How-SW views, which are what the owning tests exercise. T2's remaining 'reads legibly at default density' judgement stays perceptual under LLR-055/TC-055.

Title: Detail-in-context breadcrumb (T3 core)
Detail: The MECHANIZED core of usability anchor T3 (docs/rubrics/dashboard-usability.md), split out of LLR-055 under the WI-300 (f) ruling: descending a container never replaces the view with no way back - the drill emits a declared breadcrumb nav (<nav class="crumbs"> with a data-root-crumb root label) whose crumb click TRUNCATES the trail to that ancestor, restoring the parent view. SCOPE: the breadcrumb's presence and its restore behaviour. Whether the reader subjectively stays oriented remains perceptual under LLR-055/TC-055.

Title: Non-pruning SVG container roles (A2 core)
Detail: The MECHANIZED core of accessibility anchor A2 (docs/rubrics/dashboard-accessibility.md), split out of LLR-053 under the WI-300 (f) ruling and delivered by WI-297: no emitted <svg> declares the CHILDREN-PRESENTATIONAL role=img over a FOCUSABLE descendant, and any svg that does declare role=img carries its own accessible name (aria-label, or a first-direct-child <title> - per SVG-AAM a <title> nested in a <g> names the <g>, not the svg). Focusable means tabindex in any quoting OR a native SVG <a href>, which is tab-ordered without a tabindex; a tabindex-only predicate wrongly passed the loops diagram (9 linked stage cards) and was caught by adversarial review, not by the first test. The role is chosen from the emitted BODY by _svg_role, so a future emitter adding focusable nodes cannot silently reintroduce the conflict. SCOPE - and no wider: the container-role invariant as PROVEN by TC-104, i.e. over the artifact this repo ships plus the tiered fixture, plus the predicate's own unit cases. It is NOT a proof over every reachable emitter configuration: an emitter no rendered artifact exercises is unguarded. Whether each control READS as well-named remains perceptual under LLR-053/TC-053.

Title: One-concept-per-colour de-collision (U5 core)
Detail: The MECHANIZED core of uniformity anchor U5 (docs/rubrics/dashboard-uniformity.md), split out of LLR-054 under the WI-300 (f) ruling and delivered by WI-292 (119-CRITIQUE BLOCKER): no hex value is reused across STATUS_FILL/TIER_FILL/OKF_TYPE_FILL/SW_NODE_FILL/PHASE_ACCENTS for an unrelated concept (the intentional TIER_FILL<->OKF_TYPE_FILL SN/SR/LLR/TC mirror is the one exception, asserted as a bijection, not merely a set match), no PHASE_ACCENTS entry equals the CSS --accent token (a phase sharing it makes that phase focus/hover ring invisible), and PHASE_ACCENTS clears a PAIRWISE (not merely adjacent) deltaE>=15 floor. SCOPE: hex-identity and deltaE across these five declared palettes. Whether a reader perceives a collision the identity check misses (near-duplicate but non-identical hues outside PHASE_ACCENTS) remains perceptual under LLR-054/TC-054.

Title: Uniform node/edge/legend/highlight styling (U3 core)
Detail: The MECHANIZED core of uniformity anchor U3 (docs/rubrics/dashboard-uniformity.md), split out of LLR-054 under the WI-300 (f) ruling and delivered by WI-294 (117-CRITIQUE, 119-CRITIQUE): the hover/focus highlight ring resolves to ONE shared per-fill `--ring` custom property across every SVG emitter (drill/icicle/flat-DAG/knowledge), not a different hue per emitter (was var(--accent) in the drill views, a hardcoded amber elsewhere); and the When tab's phase-accent key renders through the SAME `.legend`/`<i>` component every other legend in the document uses, not a bespoke smaller inline-chip idiom. SCOPE: highlight-token equality and legend-component equality, asserted structurally against the emitted CSS/markup. Whether a reader perceives the RESULT as uniform (spacing, exact visual weight) remains perceptual under LLR-054/TC-054.

Title: Process-tab node-label type scale (U1 core)
Detail: The MECHANIZED core of uniformity anchor U1 (docs/rubrics/dashboard-uniformity.md), split out of LLR-054 under the WI-300 (f) ruling and delivered by WI-295 (117-CRITIQUE, 119-CRITIQUE): the Process tab's working-loops SVG no longer hardcodes 12px/9.5px/13px/13px on .stgt/.stgn/.hooplab/.hubname. .stgt/.stgn are the same per-node-label role as the shared --nlabel/--nsub tokens (icicle/dag/knowledge already share) and now reuse them directly; .hooplab/.hubname are a once-per-diagram headline label, a genuinely different role, so they take the one documented --nhead scale step instead of two independently-drifting magic numbers. SCOPE: these four selectors resolve to a declared token, asserted structurally against the emitted CSS. Whether the resulting sizes read as visually uniform remains perceptual under LLR-054/TC-054.

Title: Interactive-control contrast in both themes (T5 core)
Detail: The MECHANIZED core of usability anchor T5 (docs/rubrics/dashboard-usability.md), split out of LLR-055 under the WI-300 (f) ruling and delivered by WI-299 (116/117-CRITIQUE corroborated, 118-CRITIQUE MAJOR, 119-CRITIQUE MAJOR): the descend/hover/focus ring painted over a node's own fill (the interactive control T5 extends A4's arithmetic to) clears the WCAG 3:1 UI-boundary floor against EVERY node fill declared in STATUS_FILL/TIER_FILL/OKF_TYPE_FILL/SW_NODE_FILL/PHASE_ACCENTS, in BOTH themes -- computed per-fill (white or near-black, whichever contrasts more), not a single fixed hue that vanishes on whichever fill happens to match it (the phase-3/--accent collision measured 1.00:1). SCOPE: the ring's contrast against its host fill, arithmetic like the sibling A4 tests. Whether the affordance otherwise reads as inviting stays perceptual under LLR-055/TC-055.
